title: Chapter 65 Entering The Cell
content:
Chapter 65 Entering The Cell

Wang Shuo remained unmoved and continued to move forward.

Dongfang Ling continued to yell and curse.

It was not until she could no longer see Wang Shuo and others that she realized that they had really left.

The teleportation talisman on her body did not work in this dungeon, which was the reason why she was really panicked.

After Wang Shuo left, he continued to explore the cells in other passages.

There were basically no useful items in all the cells.

Suddenly, a withered skeleton in a cell caught his attention, and he sent Baili Liang to find out.

Unexpectedly, as soon as Baili Liang entered, the cell door closed automatically.

This scared everyone.

Wang Shuo then realized that Dongfang Ling was probably locked in the cell in the same way.

At this moment, the white bones in the cell suddenly stood up and attacked Baili Liang.

This was a level 15 white skeleton, Baili Liang was naturally no match for it, but fortunately Wang Shuo and others could also attack.

Soon, the skeleton was killed.

Baili Liang picked up the item that fell on the ground. It was a secret book of swordsmanship.

"Kuangfeng Swordsmanship", a yellow-level swordsmanship.

It was just an ordinary swordsmanship, but Wang Shuo had only obtained a copy of "Youlong Gun Jue" so far, so it was still very precious.

Wang Shuo gave this swordsmanship book to Gong Ping for use. He used a sword, so it should be the most effective for him at this moment.

"Abu, you use your sword to chop this lock first."

Ayubu chopped it hard, sparks flew everywhere, but this strange lock was intact.

"Let's go find the key first!" Wang Shuo was a little helpless. No wonder that Dongfang Ling couldn't get away either.

So everyone immediately dispersed and went to find the key.

Suddenly, Wang Shuo remembered that he must not enter the cell again.

Unfortunately, he was still a step too late, and Gong Kai was locked in a cell.

"Well, we have to save one more person." Everyone immediately came to the cell and eliminated a resurrected zombie inside.

Another swordsmanship book was obtained.

In this way, Wang Shuo and others returned to the hall of the prison.

Because they searched all other passages, but did not find any clues.

Wang Shuo also went to the passage where Dongfang Ling was.

Dongfang Ling's attitude was obviously better, and she was able to talk properly.

But Wang Shuo ignored her, and it was more important to rescue his men.

In the hall, there was a square table with four wine bowls and a wine jar on it.

Next to it, there was a whip, which was covered with dust and looked ordinary.

At first, it did not attract attention.

But at this moment, it felt a little strange.

Wang Shuo signaled Gong Zheng to pick up the whip to see if anything would change.

When Gong Zheng picked up the whip.

Three jailers and a prison boss suddenly appeared and sat on the stool.

[Wang Wu (Prison Boss)]

[Level: Level 18]

[Attack Power: 210]

[Defense Power: 40]

[Health: 4000]

"Prepare for battle!" Wang Shuo shouted immediately.

Since the incident happened suddenly and everyone was very close to the monster, the battle was about to break out.

The first person to react was not Ayub, but Guliji.

She flashed to Wang Wu's back with a backstab and slashed his neck with a knife.

"-210."

A huge blood-red number floated above his head.

With the blessing of the golden dagger and the skills, the damage of this attack was considerable.

Wang Shuo and others did not stand still and immediately launched an attack.

In the melee, Wang Shuo was also injured, but it was not a big problem.

Everyone worked together and quickly killed the prison boss and the jailer.

Looking at the dropped items, there was indeed a bunch of keys.

[Black Dragon City Dungeon Keychain +1, Soul Crystal +1, Energy Crystal +30. ]

At this time, there was also a black booklet that attracted Wang Shuo's attention.

Wang Shuo picked it up, and the system prompted:

[You have obtained the "North Sea Empire Black Dragon City Dungeon Log\
